answer: Stop sybils with randomly assigned verification kiosks. First, a new agent is assigned one of 5,000 kiosks — a library or post office — and must check in within 72 hours. Second, the kiosk scans a QR code, runs a liveness check, and stamps the identity with time and place. Third, assignment is random, so a farm cannot pre-position people, and a missed check-in burns a 200 POA bond. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 people at $100 each, $1,000,000, plus 2,000,000 POA in bonds. Like a pearl grown layer by layer, trust forms slowly; a lotus cannot bloom on a terrace built of cardboard.
